issue.title: When a message whose content contains a Markdown link is quoted in a reply, the quote block preview on iOS renders the raw Markdown source instead of a parsed l
issue.summary: When a message whose content contains a Markdown link is quoted in a reply, the quote block preview on iOS renders the raw Markdown source instead of a parsed link. The link is shown as '[https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654](https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654)', so the same URL appears twice. Reported by Aiden (seen in the group 'Payment & Team Subscriptions', Henry quoting a message from Tmly Quan). This is a regression-family sibling of #1896 but in a different render path (quote preview, not the message popup).
steps: Send a message whose content contains a link that is stored as Markdown link syntax, e.g. a GitHub PR URL (in the evidence: a message from Tmly Quan containing https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654).
Long-press that message and choose Quote/Reply, then send a reply (in the evidence: Henry replying with an image + text).
Open the conversation on the iOS app and look at the quote block shown above the reply bubble.
issue.expected: The quote block preview shows the quoted message as plain display text: the link appears only once (either the URL or its label, optionally as a link), with no Markdown syntax such as '[', '](' or ')'. The preview should match how the original message bubble renders the link.
issue.actual: The quote block preview prints the Markdown link source verbatim: '[https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654](https://github.com/TensorOpera-Inc/chat-web/pull/654) 测...'. The URL is displayed twice (once as the label in brackets, once as the target in parentheses), taking two lines of the preview and truncating the actual quoted text.
issue.featureArea: Messaging / UI - Quote (reply) block preview, Markdown link rendering
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Messaging / UI - Quote (reply) block preview, Markdown link rendering
- Reported by Aiden. cc @Diff-Jack (Jack) @cola-coding (Cora).
- Location: the duplication is INSIDE the quote block (quoted preview), not in the reply body. The reply body text renders normally.
- Type of duplication: raw Markdown link syntax '[text](url)' left unparsed (label == url, so the URL shows twice). It is NOT a plain-text URL being copied, and no 'mailto:' link is involved.
- Related: #1896 (message popup renders a URL as duplicated '[link]link'). Same symptom family - Markdown link markup leaking into a read-only display surface - but a different render path: the quote preview appears to build its summary from the raw message content without a Markdown parse/strip step. Suggest fixing both with a shared 'markdown to plain preview text' helper used by quote preview, popup, conversation-list snippet and notifications.
- Evidence screenshot (original): https://teamily-storage.becdn.net/im/images/6296335850356299/773dd378-7d4f-43bc-9280-19f3e2a75770.IMG_8054.jpg

---
issue.environment: - **Platform / OS / Browser**: iOS app (confirmed from screenshot); Web / macOS / Android not verified - please check whether the quote preview component is shared
